## Contributor consent

**Required for every contribution from anyone other than the copyright holder.**
A pull request alone does not record consent, and a pull request without the
statement below is not merged.

Post this as a comment on this pull request, filling in your name or GitHub
handle and the date:

> I have read and agree to the VOLDBASE Contribution Terms in `LICENSE`
> section 8 for the contributions in this pull request. I confirm that I am the
> author of these contributions or have the right to submit them, that I retain
> copyright in them, and that I have authority to grant the licence in `LICENSE`
> section 8.4 for the whole contribution.
>
> Signed: _your name or GitHub handle_, _date (YYYY-MM-DD)_

If you are contributing on behalf of an organisation or as part of work for a
commercial entity, say so in the same comment and do not submit until that
entity has agreed separate written terms with the copyright holder.

## Maintainer check

- [ ] A consent statement from the contributor is recorded on this pull request
      (link it here), or the contribution is by the copyright holder.
- [ ] The statement has not been edited or supplied on the contributor's behalf.
